cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: I might be misreading, but wouldnt using `domain_found` to check for domains break previous impl, in other words, be a breaking change? Though im sure it might be rare (and would just be an additional san entry iirc), but there could be instances where one would have a certificate for a specific ip, no? If thats the route we are to go, it might be best to do a minor bump instead of a patch bump to the version.
